text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The government to tighten gun law. The Transitional National Council will vote on weapons legislation proposed by the defence ministry.
- Fresh meat prices soared as the authorities stopped importing meat since last April because of fears stemming from the so-called mad cow disease in Europe.

- The authorities are about to reach accords with Cuba and Spain to send medicines processing specialists to help Algeria set up its own medicine industry. The move will save hundreds of millions dollars on the import bil and disarm an importers "mafia".
- The government to set up new 14 law courts.
- The Transitional National Council will vote a new trade law providing for new forms of contracts with foreign firms and liberalising more imports and exports.
